name: holder-catalogue
description: Tool-holder catalogue and stock tally for a CNC shop (HSK-A63 first; any taper form later)
author: Holder Catalogue
//electron: Pinned to the same Electron that RFQ Agent ships (42.11.8, Node 24). The database uses Node's built-in node:sqlite, so there is no native module to rebuild for Electron's ABI — the installer build is a plain electron-builder run.

scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
